scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Farm, Auto Serve, Collect + More
scripts.features:
This Restaurant Tycoon 3 script uses the Obsidian UI library and opens with RightAlt, driving the game’s own Events remotes rather than custom calls. Its Auto Farm section covers cooking (auto or instant), seating customers, taking orders, giving food, collecting dirty dishes, bills, tips, drive-thru service, calming rude customers, and collecting dropped money or Food Critic rewards. Restaurant controls let you open, close, or empty your restaurant, rename it, and auto-buy selected upgrades from a dropdown of every available purchase. A Farm tab handles auto planting, harvesting, and destroying crops across all eight tiles, plus auto-buying ingredients from the Farm Shop and a general ingredient list. Shop tabs automate purchases from the Supermarket, Butcher, Fishmonger, and Bakery, each with its own ingredient dropdown and teleport button. Teleports also cover your tycoon, Plaza, EKEA, Campsite, and Farm through the game’s own TeleportRequestedClient remote. Player settings include an FPS cap, music selection and purchase, anti-AFK, infinite jump, fly with speed control, noclip, FOV and camera zoom sliders, custom walk speed with normal or CFrame mode, jump power, and gravity. Rewards automation claims daily rewards, collects objective rewards, redeems two valid codes, and uses Obsidian’s ThemeManager and SaveManager for saved configs.

Restaurant Tycoon 3, RT3, Restaurant Tycoon
